title: Smooth between snapshots
description:
Draw other players between two snapshots, slightly in the past.

```
snapshot t=100: x=0
snapshot t=150: x=10
render at t=110 -> x=2
render at t=140 -> x=8
render at t=170 -> x=10 (no newer snapshot: hold)
```
hints: Find the first snapshot with `time > t`; the one before it is the start (lesson 6.03).
requirements: `lerp(a, b, t)` and a function that finds the two snapshots around the render time.
Render 100 ms behind the newest snapshot.
Hold the last position when the render time passes the newest snapshot.
stretch: Interpolate angles too, taking the short way round 360°.
